purpose: Define View-type UserModule behavior as read/projection-only presentation over explicit canonical/runtime sources, with mutations routed through separate explicit commands/operations.

does_not_own: presentation semantics outside declared view scope

topics.name: UserModule View Projection
topics.purpose: Define View-type UserModule behavior as read/projection-only presentation over explicit canonical/runtime sources, with mutations routed through separate explicit commands/operations.

semantics.source_rule: View reads explicit semantic/runtime source refs.
semantics.projection_rule: View transforms source data into presentation state only.
semantics.write_rule: View itself owns no backend mutation semantics.
semantics.action_rule: Interactive actions may invoke separate explicit canonical commands/operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Visibility/renderability does not grant read/write/invoke authority beyond evaluated policy.
semantics.state_rule: UI-local state is separate from canonical source/runtime state.
semantics.identity_rule: View identity is distinct from the source semantic identity it presents.

invariants.rule: UserModule type behavior is explicit and narrow: input acquires/writes inert data, adapter translates/mounts, view projects, and no type silently acquires another type's authority.

hard_gates.condition: view directly mutates backend outside explicit operation
UI-local state written as canonical source implicitly
view identity conflated with presented source
view hides mutation behind presentation callback

references.purpose: Interactive view actions use normal operation boundary.
